description: Transfer of 01 Acre Land at Wedamulla, Kelaniya to Police Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to transfer 01 acre of land at Wedamulla, Kelaniya, to the Police Department, was approved by the Cabinet.
